appDescription: This application helps you manage your hiking and running activities more effectively. Here are some features of the app:
featureTrackingTitle: Track your hiking and running activities
featureTrackingDescription: The app tracks your current location via GPS during each new hiking or running activity and draws your route on the map.
featureRealTimeDataDescription: You can view real-time information such as distance, duration, and average speed recorded during the activity.
featureDataStorageDescription: Once you complete your activity, this information is saved in the app's database. You can later review, analyze, and examine your past activities in detail.
featureWeatherDescription: The app provides weather information, allowing you to plan according to weather conditions.
appSummary: With the app, you can gain comprehensive insights into both your current and past activities, helping you manage your sports habits more effectively.
